Inside the Collection

Little Intentions, waiting to unfold

Basket Warm · Woven · Rooted

Handcrafted from natural kauna grass in Manipur — a time-honoured craft bringing warmth and character into any space. A tactile piece with a life beyond the hamper, for keepsakes, letters and everyday treasures.

Singing Bowl Resonant · Grounding · Timeless

Shaped through repeated hammering, its deep resonance creates a moment of pause — a gentle invitation towards stillness and coming back to the present.

Flower Tea & Glass Infuser Gentle · Floral · Soothing

Carefully picked chamomile, blue corn & rose buds, paired with a glass infuser for moments when slowing down feels just right. Flowers unfolding in warm water, a slow sip, a softer moment.

Wax Sachet — Coffee Aromatic · Comforting · Atmospheric

Hand-poured fragrant soy wax, warm rich and familiar. A little aromatic comfort for linens, wardrobes, drawers or even the car.

Wax Sachet — Rainforest Aromatic · Comforting · Atmospheric

Hand-poured fragrant soy wax, fresh earthy and calming. A softer atmosphere wherever a little lift is needed.

Linen Cotton Napkins Natural · Textured · Everyday

A tactile cotton-linen weave chosen to bring warmth and ease to the everyday table — for morning tea, a slow meal, or small gatherings made a little more special.
